opening.argument: The material provides a concrete participation procedure tied directly to claimed BNB returns. It tells viewers to copy contract code, send 0.2 BNB to the contract, and call the flashloan function in Remix. The promised result is not merely technical: the description says, “the transaction sender (Us) gains 2.51 BNB from the arbitrage,” while also stating that profits can be repeated until a daily limit is reached. The speaker reinforces that financial claim by describing “2.57 BNB uh in profit as a result of this script.” Although the amount is said to vary with liquidity, the video still combines transfer instructions, contract execution, and a stated repeatable profit opportunity.

citations.quote: Send 0.2 BNB to the contract for gas fee for all swaps

The profits will be credited in BNB, and this can be repeated until the daily limit is reached.
